name: What are some common accessibility upgrades for bathrooms and kitchens?

mainEntity.name: What are some common accessibility upgrades for bathrooms and kitchens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common bathroom accessibility upgrades include installing grab bars near toilets and in showers, creating roll-in or curbless showers, raising toilet heights, and incorporating non-slip flooring. For kitchens, popular modifications involve lowering counter heights, installing pull-out shelves or drawers, optimizing appliance placement for easy reach, and adding touchless faucets. These changes aim to enhance safety and independence in high-use areas of the home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom upgrades often include grab bars, roll-in showers, and raised toilets. Kitchens benefit from lowered counters, pull-out shelves, and optimized appliance placement to enhance access.
